title: Pile of Diamonds
coreRelationships: The diamonds are clustered together, creating a sense of abundance and density.
Light interacts with the facets, producing sharp highlights and deep shadows that define the form of each diamond.
The arrangement of diamonds is organic and seemingly random, yet fills the frame almost entirely.
The background is a soft, out-of-focus white, emphasizing the brilliance of the diamonds.
reuseFormula: Generate a close-up, high-key photograph of a dense pile of clear, faceted diamonds with varying cuts and sizes, scattered across a light, reflective surface. Ensure strong internal reflections and refractions, creating a complex interplay of light and shadow, with subtle rainbow glints visible in some facets. The background should be a soft, out-of-focus white. If text is required, add a small, black rectangular box with a thin white border in the bottom right corner. Inside, place 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' in bold, white, uppercase sans-serif, and 'EXPLICIT CONTENT' in regular, white, uppercase sans-serif below it, with a small white starburst graphic to the left of the top line.
